# `user_account`

Global sign-in identity (IAM-04). Visible to a tenant only through its own membership. Holds no profile data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | aggregate-root |
| Tenant scope | Not tenant scoped |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `identity-access`: Access records kept for security review after revocation. Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | /v1/members/{id}/account (planned) |
| Write path | membership_invite() creates or links by normalized email. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0002_identity_org (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (id)
- unique email
- email lower-case, trimmed, contains @, <= 320 chars
- status in (active, disabled)
- RLS: readable only when a membership in the current tenant references it
